title: Align environment and Git context semantics
objective: Bring Go environment and Git context content up to original fidelity and robustness.
context: The original environment prompt includes primary cwd, git repo status, additional working directories, platform, shell, OS version, model information, worktree warnings, and knowledge cutoff.
The original Git status uses --no-optional-locks, includes current branch, main branch, git user, clean state, recent commits, and snapshot wording.
Go currently provides a smaller Git context block from simple git commands.
deliverables: Add environment context builder with primary working directory, additional directories, platform, shell, and OS version.
Add optional model description and knowledge cutoff hooks if model catalog data is available.
Use --no-optional-locks for git status and git log calls.
Include current branch, default/main branch, git user, status, and recent commits.
Add clean status placeholder when working tree is clean.
Add snapshot wording that clarifies Git status does not update during the conversation.
Support a disable-git-instructions setting or environment gate.
acceptance: Non-git directories return no Git status without error.
Long status output truncates around 2000 characters with an explanatory suffix.
Git context is injected through SystemContext from task_03, not base static prompt.
Tests cover clean repo, dirty repo, non-git directory, and timeout/error behavior.
non_goals: Do not implement the full settings subsystem.
Do not change Git tool execution behavior.
handoff_notes: Use temporary git repositories in tests and keep timeouts short.
